reuse.why: Every site now calls the existing getScheduledAmount helper for the range, though four sites keep their own missing/number dispatch that the helper already handles.

duplication.why: The five inline midpoint formulas are replaced by the shared helper; the retained 'missing ? 0 : number ? value : helper' ternaries are redundant with the helper but not new logic.

placement.why: The rule changes in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, which client and server code already use.

scope.why: Only the helper, the five call sites, their comments and a focused test change.

maintainability.why: One definition of the rule now; a maintainer would only want the leftover per-site dispatch collapsed into plain getScheduledAmount calls.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount; schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions all call it for ranged amounts.
